watch.thesis: Energy is the nearest challenger to crowded, mean-reverting bank leadership, with stronger trend durability and broad participation. Watch for a confirmed handoff—not an anticipated rotation.
watch.confirmation_condition: By 2026-12-11, energy overtakes banks and remains leader across multiple observations while staying absolute-trend eligible with breadth near or above 0.70.
watch.retire_condition: Retire if energy loses absolute-trend eligibility, breadth falls below 0.50, or banks retain leadership through the check date.
